premium.title: Musclog Premium
premium.benefit: Hosted AI with no key to set up. Musclog Premium runs the AI for you on a monthly allowance.
premium.useForAiHint: Requests go to the Musclog Premium service, which forwards them to OpenRouter.
premium.resetBody: This forgets this device's Premium enrollment and makes a new device key. Your subscription is not cancelled. Restore purchases adds this device back.

consent.title: Send AI requests to Premium?
consent.body: Your messages, and any photos you send to the AI, go to the Musclog Premium service. It forwards them to OpenRouter, which sends them to the AI model provider. Only zero data retention (ZDR) endpoints are used: those providers do not keep your content or use it for training. Musclog's service keeps only usage counts, never your messages or photos. You can switch this off at any time.

premium.renewalDisclosure: Musclog Premium is a monthly subscription that renews automatically. Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account at confirmation. It renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your store account settings. The price shown is what the store charges.
premium.devicesNote: One subscription and one allowance, shared by all your devices.
premium.platformsNote: iOS and Android subscriptions are separate.
